Players Committee card image of [[Corporal Delevar (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Once per game, may deploy 2-1B here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, if present at a site, may 'operate' on your Disarmed character (or your just 'hit' non-droid character of ability < 4) present here; character is restored to normal.”
